_comment: Hand-checked ground truth for the synthetic orders/customers/inventory corpus in this directory -- every foreign-key relationship a human reading the DDL would call real, whether or not sql.py's regex extractor actually finds it. tests/kb/test_sql_fixture_corpus.py runs the corpus through index_repo_dir and scores the emitted `references` edges against this list: precision/recall for the SQL parser, quantified rather than asserted. `detectable: false` entries are documented, by-design misses (self-referencing FKs, and FKs attached via a separate ALTER TABLE statement) -- see the comment in the matching .sql file for why. This file has no real customer/company schema in it; every table and relationship was invented for this fixture.
